Review and test everything against the assignment. Check query combinations, validation order, PUT defaults, response formats, and two-way references. Verify that failed requests leave the database unchanged. Fix issues and explain what you found.

Here's my Render URL, https://cs409-mp3-manojkmohan5.onrender.com. Check the live API, set API_URL in submit.js without changing AUTOGRADER_URL, and run the self-check. Check if there are any failures, if yes fix them, and tell me if I need to redeploy.
